aster:state:01.source_title: The Meridian Isles · authored synthetic fixture
aster:state:01.recorded_from: Synthetic fixture; no historical recorded-time claim
methodology: Discrete authored polygons; no smoothing or interpolation.
One independent point label per active entity, shared by every fragment.
Population cards integrate density over the covered part of each footprint. Missing density coverage is not treated as zero.
Fixed reference uses the authored 950 CE footprint with the current epoch’s density. Area uses a spherical equal-area approximation.
limitations: Every name, border, density and movement is invented.
Partial density coverage gives a subtotal, not a total territory population.
The map uses vector-tile quantization; the fixed reference retains authored input geometry.
